.name: Look up badges and card progress
.note: Read a page of badges and the Steam level. Omit SteamID or specify your card page to also read your own card progress.
.description: Read a page of badges and the Steam level. Omit SteamID or specify your card page to also read your own card progress.
.parameters.steamId: SteamID64 as a string. Omit to use the signed-in Steam account.
.parameters.start: Zero-based offset. Continue with the previous result's nextStart.
.parameters.limit: 1 to 100 entries per page. The default is 25.
.parameters.cardPage: Trading card page for the signed-in account, starting at 1. Continue with cards.nextPage.
